purpose: Validate public-history output inventory bounds across all72 old exposed episodes before using them in sale timing.
inputs: Consecutive legal own observations, own post-worker output stock and own submitted orders; public game rules. No rival private stock/actions or future input.
primary_checks: No underestimated collected output or total carried+shed output compared with engine truth.
Exact rival sale quantities when the market phase stayed above floor; valid lower bounds otherwise.
Own accepted output-sale quantities agree with engine.
secondary: How often it proves absence of stored product; frequency of conservative false risk; runtime. No policy performance claim from bound accuracy.
scope: Carrot,tomato,strawberry,melon,egg,milk,wool only. History begins at standard empty-stock game start. Day-end deposits cap per-product possible stock at shed capacity. Ambiguous destruction counts as possible harvest.
